pillar: P3 提示詞範本（範本清單）
hook_zh: 同一個提示詞，每次輸出可能不一樣。
caption_zh:
【AI 虛擬角色】本影片由 AI 生成的虛擬角色「步驟」說明，畫面中的角色為 AI 生成，並非真人；螢幕錄影由工作室真人操作。資料日期：{YYYY/MM/DD}。
錄製條件：{工具}｜{版本}｜{方案}｜{YYYY/MM/DD}　由工作室真人操作錄製
提示詞範本（通用，工作室自撰）：
請把下面這封信整理成三行重點，使用臺灣慣用的繁體中文。
每行不超過 20 個字，保留所有日期與數字，不要新增原文沒有的內容。
不確定的地方，請在最後另起一行標示。
（在這裡貼上信件內容）
範例信件為工作室自撰，內容虛構。真正的文件貼上前，先確認沒有個資。
示範輸出不代表每次相同；標示不確定，不代表內容正確。
本頻道與影片中提到的工具廠商無隸屬或合作關係。
#提示詞 #AI工具 #範本
caption_gloss_en:
[AI virtual character] This video is explained by the AI-generated virtual character "Buzhou"; the character on screen is AI-generated and is not a real person; the screen recording is operated by a real person at the studio. Data date: {date}.
Recording conditions: {tool} | {version} | {plan} | {date}  operated and recorded by a real person at the studio
Prompt template (general, written by the studio):
Please turn the letter below into three key lines, in the Traditional Chinese commonly used in Taiwan.
No more than 20 characters per line; keep all dates and numbers; do not add anything the original does not say.
Where you are unsure, mark it on a separate last line.
(Paste the letter here)
The sample letter was written by the studio and its content is fictional. With a real document, first make sure it holds no personal data.
Demonstration output is not the same every time; marking something uncertain does not make the content correct.
This channel has no affiliation or partnership with the tool vendors mentioned in the video.
#提示詞 #AI工具 #範本
on_screen_label_zh: AI 生成｜虛擬角色（每一影格都有；後製加上，不由生成工具繪製）。另有「錄製條件」「資料來源」標籤，內容見行事曆

sources.claim: Hedged general statement 「同一個提示詞，每次輸出可能不一樣」: a vendor help or documentation page stating that outputs can vary between runs (URL by the operator). Without it the line stays hedged with 可能 and rests on the two recorded runs, which cannot prove it if the runs match.
Recording conditions on the strip are read from the app's own about or account screen at recording time (frame grab).

NO FACTUAL CLAIM about any vendor: the template text is original, written by the studio (sample kit item C); the digits in each output are checked against the fictional sample letter (sample kit item A).

media.description: HUMAN SCREEN RECORDING (no generation tool): S3_rec_raw_01.mp4, Takes 1 to 4 of calendar-30d.md section 5 M3 (the fictional sample letter; run 1 and run 2 in two separate new chats with the same pasted template; compare dates and numbers), no audio, untouched. Both runs are shown, no choosing the nicer one.

Log it in assets/provenance.csv as a human-made asset (tool: the recorder and its version; prompt: 'none, screen recording by the operator').

media.description: Stills of the openly-AI character for the corner picture-in-picture, from the approved photoreal golden set: E06, E04, E07, E01 and R06 right (pack pipeline/image-pack/buzhou-photoreal.md sections 4.1 and 4.4). STILL IMAGES ONLY: no animation, no lip-sync, no voice (photoreal addendum 7, risk 8). Square crops are made on copies and logged with their parent file; never flipped. Alt text for any still posted alone: AI 生成的虛擬角色步驟，示意圖，非真人。
media.shot_prompt: PREFER REUSE of the approved golden-set files (R06_pr_pip_right_v1, R03_pr_E01_v1, E04, E06, E07 as listed); do not generate new images for this Short. If a file is missing or not approved, generate it with its own prompt in pipeline/image-pack/buzhou-photoreal.md (section 4.1 for E01 to E10, section 4.4 for R06); the prompt is not repeated here so the pack stays the single source of truth. Never upload a photograph of any real person. No provider adapter is called by this file; generation is manual until the operator supplies an image-API key (pipeline adapters stay inert).
